metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the IGES CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), with an executable [iges](/workspace/output/iges) launcher. It supports all five subcommands, the 87-type entity catalog, native curve and surface evaluation, fixed-format writing, and spec-referenced diagnostics using only Node.js standard libraries.

Verified syntax, 80-column output, byte-identical repeat roundtrips, representative geometry and topology cases, and malformed-input errors.
